turns.query: On October 5, 2025, identify the hour when any weather station recorded the highest wind speed of the day. For the air quality monitoring station closest to that windiest weather station, by what percentage was the NO2 concentration at that peak-wind hour lower than the station's daily average NO2? (Round to 1 decimal place, positive value means reduction)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text
import numpy as np

# Step 1: Fetch wind speed data for all weather stations on October 5, 2025
# Find the station and hour with maximum wind speed
query_max_wind = text("""
SELECT hsw.station_id, hsw.datetime, hsw.wind_speed, ws.name_en as station_name
FROM hourly_station_weather hsw
JOIN weather_station ws ON hsw.station_id = ws.id
WHERE hsw.datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00'
AND hsw.datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
ORDER BY hsw.wind_speed DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
max_wind_df = pd.read_sql(query_max_wind, engine)
print("=== Maximum Wind Speed Record ===")
print(max_wind_df)

# Step 2: Get coordinates for the windiest weather station
windiest_station_id = max_wind_df['station_id'].values[0]
windiest_station_name = max_wind_df['station_name'].values[0]
windiest_station_lat = max_wind_df['datetime'].values[0]  # placeholder

query_windiest_coords = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as latitude, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as longitude
FROM weather_station
WHERE id = %d
""" % windiest_station_id)
windiest_coords = pd.read_sql(query_windiest_coords, engine)
print("\n=== Windiest Weather Station Coordinates ===")
print(windiest_coords)

# Step 3: Get coordinates for all air quality monitoring stations
query_aqs_coords = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as latitude, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as longitude
FROM air_quality_station
""")
aqs_coords = pd.read_sql(query_aqs_coords, engine)
print("\n=== All Air Quality Station Coordinates ===")
print(aqs_coords)

# Step 4: Find the closest air quality station to the windiest weather station
windiest_lat = windiest_coords['latitude'].values[0]
windiest_lon = windiest_coords['longitude'].values[0]

query_closest_aqs = text("""
SELECT aqs.id, aqs.name_en, 
    ST_Distance(
        aqs.coordinate::geography,
        ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(%s, %s), 4326)::geography
    ) as distance_meters
FROM air_quality_station aqs
ORDER BY distance_meters
LIMIT 1
""" % (windiest_lon, windiest_lat))

closest_aqs = pd.read_sql(query_closest_aqs, engine)
print("\n=== Closest Air Quality Station ===")
print(closest_aqs)

# Step 5: Fetch hourly NO2 data for the closest air quality station on October 5, 2025
closest_station_id = closest_aqs['id'].values[0]
closest_station_name = closest_aqs['name_en'].values[0]

query_hourly_no2 = text("""
SELECT datetime, no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = %d
AND datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
ORDER BY datetime
""" % closest_station_id)

hourly_no2_df = pd.read_sql(query_hourly_no2, engine)
print("\n=== Hourly NO2 Data for Closest Station (%s) ===" % closest_station_name)
print(hourly_no2_df)

# Step 6: Calculate daily NO2 statistics
daily_no2_stats = hourly_no2_df.agg({
    'no2': ['mean', 'max', 'min', 'std']
}).round(2)
print("\n=== Daily NO2 Statistics for Closest Station ===")
print(daily_no2_stats)

# Stage results for synthesis agent
windiest_station_id_var = windiest_station_id
windiest_station_name_var = windiest_station_name
windiest_hour_var = max_wind_df['datetime'].values[0]
max_wind_speed_var = max_wind_df['wind_speed'].values[0]
closest_aqs_id_var = closest_station_id
closest_aqs_name_var = closest_station_name
hourly_no2_var = hourly_no2_df
daily_no2_mean_var = daily_no2_stats.loc['mean', 'no2']
daily_no2_max_var = daily_no2_stats.loc['max', 'no2']
daily_no2_min_var = daily_no2_stats.loc['min', 'no2']

print("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
print(f"Windiest station: {windiest_station_name_var} (ID: {windiest_station_id_var})")
print(f"Max wind speed: {max_wind_speed_var} m/s at {windiest_hour_var}")
print(f"Closest AQ station: {closest_aqs_name_var} (ID: {closest_aqs_id_var})")
print(f"Daily NO2 - Mean: {daily_no2_mean_var}, Max: {daily_no2_max_var}, Min: {daily_no2_min_var} µg/m³")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Find the highest wind speed and its station/hour on October 5, 2025
query_max_wind = text("""
SELECT station_id, wind_speed, datetime
FROM hourly_station_weather
WHERE datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00'
  AND datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
ORDER BY wind_speed DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
max_wind_df = pd.read_sql(query_max_wind, engine)
print("Max wind speed record:")
print(max_wind_df)

# Get the windiest station details
windiest_station_id = max_wind_df['station_id'].values[0]
max_wind_speed = max_wind_df['wind_speed'].values[0]
windiest_hour = max_wind_df['datetime'].values[0]
print(f"\nWindiest station ID: {windiest_station_id}")
print(f"Max wind speed: {max_wind_speed}")
print(f"Windiest hour: {windiest_hour}")

# Get station name and coordinates
query_windiest_coords = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as lon, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as lat
FROM weather_station
WHERE id = :sid
""")
windiest_coords = pd.read_sql(query_windiest_coords, engine, params={'sid': windiest_station_id})
print(f"\nWindiest station: {windiest_coords['name_en'].values[0]}")
print(f"Coordinates: lat={windiest_coords['lat'].values[0]}, lon={windiest_coords['lon'].values[0]}")

# Check actual wind speed data for station 3 on Oct 5, 2025
query_check = text("""
SELECT station_id, wind_speed, datetime
FROM hourly_station_weather
WHERE station_id = 3
  AND datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00'
  AND datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
ORDER BY wind_speed DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
""")
check_df = pd.read_sql(query_check, engine)
print("Station 3 wind speeds on Oct 5:")
print(check_df)

# Also check all stations for max wind speed on that day

ORDER BY wind_speed DESC
LIMIT 10
""")
all_max_df = pd.read_sql(query_all_max, engine)
print("\nTop 10 wind speeds across all stations:")
print(all_max_df)

""")

windiest_lon = windiest_station['lon'].values[0]

           aqs.coordinate::geography,
           ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lon, :lat), 4326)::geography

ORDER BY distance_m

closest_aqs_name = closest_aqs['name_en'].values[0]
print(f"\nClosest AQS ID: {closest_aqs_id}, Name: {closest_aqs_name}")
